THE PROBLEM

The content treadmill doesn't end

You know you should be posting. You know consistency matters. But every post means finding a topic, recording something usable, editing it, writing captions for six platforms, and resizing everything.

So it doesn't happen. Or it happens for three weeks and then stops.

Crucible removes every step between “I have something to say” and “it's published.”

PROCEDURE

How it works

  1. STEP 01

    Onboarding

    Enter your website and answer a few questions. Crucible analyzes both to build a brand voice profile: tone, vocabulary, do-and-don't-say lists, audience, and content pillars. You review and approve it before anything gets written.

  2. STEP 02

    Capture

    Crucible suggests daily topic prompts based on your business. Record or upload directly in the app. Director Mode coaches you through A-roll and B-roll shooting so the footage is actually usable.

  3. STEP 03

    Process

    Your footage is transcribed, then an AI editorial director re-cuts it: hook-first reordering, tangent and stutter removal, B-roll placement. Every edit is validated against runtime budgets and sentence-boundary rules, then rendered with brand cards, loudness normalization, and captions you can edit or export as .vtt or .srt.

  4. STEP 04

    Content

    Crucible writes posts in your brand voice for the platforms you actually use — Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, TikTok — plus a full blog post, with optional AI-generated images.

  5. STEP 05

    Ship

    Review and edit everything. Not happy with the cut? Magic Revision takes your plain-language feedback and re-edits the video. Then export files or publish directly via webhook or HighLevel.

DIFFERENCE

Not a template generator

Your voice, modeled

Most AI content tools produce the same beige output for everyone. Crucible builds an approved brand voice profile first — vocabulary, tone, and explicit do-not-say rules — and writes against it.

Real video editing

Not trimming. An editorial pass: hook restructuring, filler removal, B-roll placement, and audio normalization, driven by transcript and audio-energy analysis.

Feedback that works

Magic Revision accepts plain-language notes — “make the opening punchier,” “cut the part about pricing” — and re-cuts accordingly.

TECHNICAL RECORD

Under the hood

React and Vite on Vercel. Fastify API with pg-boss workers running in Docker on Fly.io. Supabase for Postgres, magic-link auth, and storage. Deepgram for transcription. Claude orchestrated through tool-use schemas for editorial decisions, with Kimi and Gemini in the pipeline. ffmpeg for rendering. A Python sidecar running librosa and spaCy for energy and silence analysis that feeds the edit decisions. Expo companion app for capture.
